parts:
I have tried using both Chrome and Safari to save my Map Predictions as PNGs. With Chrome, the file will not download and says "the site was not available".  With Safari, the file downloads, but when I try to open it, I get told an error has occurred. I really need to download my predictions as PNGs. Does anyone know how to fix this issue?
Thank you!

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: How to save Map Prediction as a PNG
parts:
Hi,
Try installing the package "webshot", then run Wallace again and see if it works...

install.packages("webshot")
library(webshot)
run_wallace()
